description: Use this when a user asks what a public transport journey costs under the published fare table, for example a metro ride of a given distance for an adult, senior or student, in Sydney and NSW (Opal) (country AU), Spain high-speed rail (country ES), Paris region (country FR), London (Underground) (country GB), Hong Kong (MTR) (country HK), Singapore (country SG), Singapore buses (country SG) or Taiwan (Taipei Metro) (country TW). Returns the posted fare for the journey with the fare group, distance band and time band, the period, and the official source and licence. These are posted fares set by the operator or regulator, the same for everyone in a fare group, not amounts paid by individuals and not a ticket or a quote; there is no sample size and no range. How fresh: Sydney and NSW (Opal): updated when fares change (yearly, around 1 July); the table read 3 Nov 2026 carried the fares effective from 29 June 2026; Spain high-speed rail: monthly series, published quarterly by CNMC (newest month read on 31 Oct 2026: June 2026); Paris region: updated by the publisher when fares change (the list read 29 Oct 2026 had been modified on 28 Oct 2026); London (Underground): updated by TfL when fares change (the annual change takes effect in March; the table read on 9 Nov 2026 runs 1 Nov 2026 to 1 Nov 2027); Hong Kong (MTR): updated by the MTR Corporation when fares change; the file read on 5 Nov 2026 was last modified 2 Apr 2026; Singapore: updated when fares change (yearly fare review; the table read 29 Oct 2026 carried the fares effective from 27 Dec 2025); Singapore buses: updated when fares change (yearly fare review; the table read 5 Nov 2026 carried the fares effective from 27 Dec 2025); Taiwan (Taipei Metro): irregular: updated by the operator when fares change; the file name carries its date. Do not use for taxis or ride-hailing, flights, fuel, a personal quote or passes, or for countries that are not listed.

country.description: AU = Australia (New South Wales only: Opal card fares for Sydney, Newcastle, Central Coast, Illawarra and the Blue Mountains from Transport for NSW, AUD, a posted tariff); ES = Spain (high-speed rail from Madrid to Barcelona, Valencia, Alicante, Málaga or Sevilla: CNMC's monthly average posted web fare per operator, EUR; a posted fare, not tickets sold); FR = France (Île-de-France only: the Paris region single ticket and Navigo-type passes from the Île-de-France Mobilités tariff list, EUR, a posted tariff); GB = London Underground only (Transport for London posted adult fares between 20 central and main stations, GBP; buses, DLR, Elizabeth line, National Rail and the rest of Britain are not included); HK = Hong Kong (MTR train fares between two stations from the MTR Corporation's open data, HKD, a posted tariff; Airport Express, Light Rail and MTR Bus not included); SG = Singapore (MRT and LRT card fares per ride from the Public Transport Council fare table, SGD, a posted tariff; bus fares not included); SG = Singapore (trunk bus card and cash fares per ride from the Public Transport Council fare table, SGD, a posted tariff; add service=bus); TW = Taiwan (Taipei Metro fares between two stations from the operator's open data, TWD, a posted tariff; other lines and operators not included)

destination_station.description: TW only (required): the Taipei Metro station you end at, by English name such as 'Taipei 101' or 'Songshan Airport', or Chinese name such as 西門.

distance_km.description: Journey distance in kilometres (default 5). The fare is looked up in the published distance band. Australia (NSW Opal): trip distance in km (default 5); the fare is read from the published band (train 0-10, 10-20, 20-35, 35-65, 65+ km; bus, light rail 0-3, 3-8, 8+ km; ferry 0-9, 9+ km). Spain (rail): not used, the fare is per route; give route instead. France (Île-de-France): not used, the single ticket costs the same for any distance in the region. London (Underground): not used; the fare depends on the two stations, so give tfl_from and tfl_to. Hong Kong (MTR): not used; the fare depends on the two stations, so give from_station and to_station. Singapore: ride distance in km (default 5); the fare is read from the published 1 km band. Singapore bus: ride distance in km (default 5); the fare is read from the published band. Taiwan (Taipei Metro): not used; the fare depends on the two stations, so give origin_station and destination_station.

fare_type.description: Fare group (default adult). The groups available depend on the country notes. Australia (NSW Opal): adult (default); student = the Child/Youth Opal fare; senior = the Senior/Pensioner concession fare (capped at AUD 2.50 a day). workfare and disability are not available. Spain (rail): not used, CNMC publishes one average fare per route and operator; leave out. France (Île-de-France): adult = single ticket Métro-Train-RER (default); student = annual Imagine R student pass. Seniors and disabled people get percentage discounts, not a fixed fare. London (Underground): adult only (default); child, student and concession fares are not available. Hong Kong (MTR): adult (default), senior = the elderly concession fare, or disability = the concession fare for persons with a disability. student and workfare are not available. Singapore: adult (default), senior, student, workfare or disability. Singapore bus: adult (default), senior, student, workfare or disability. Taiwan (Taipei Metro): adult (default, the full fare), or senior / disability (both give the one concession fare for senior, Love and companion card holders and children in Taipei and New Taipei). student and workfare are not available.

from_station.description: HK only (required): the MTR station you start at, by English name such as 'Central' or 'Tsim Sha Tsui'.

mode.description: AU (NSW Opal) only: train (default), bus, light_rail or ferry.

operator.description: Spain (rail) only: total = all operators together (default), renfe-ave, renfe-avlo, iryo or ouigo. An operator CNMC did not see on that route in the newest month gives an error listing those it did.

origin_station.description: TW only (required): the Taipei Metro station you start at, by English name such as 'Taipei Main Station' or 'Tamsui', or Chinese name such as 台北車站.

payment.description: SG bus only: card (default) or cash.

route.description: Spain (rail) only: Madrid-Barcelona (default), Madrid-Valencia, Madrid-Alicante, Madrid-Málaga or Madrid-Sevilla, or just the destination (Barcelona, Seville...).

service.description: SG only: bus = trunk bus fares; leave out for MRT and LRT fares.

tfl_from.description: GB only (required): the London Underground station you start at, by name such as "King's Cross", "Victoria", "Oxford Circus" or "Heathrow Terminal 5" (20 central and main stations).

tfl_ticket.description: GB only: payg (Oyster or contactless pay as you go, default) or cash (single paper ticket).

tfl_time.description: GB only: peak (default, Mon-Fri 06:30-09:30 and 16:00-19:00) or off-peak. Ignored for cash and for journeys with one all-day fare.

tfl_to.description: GB only (required): the London Underground station you end at, by name such as "Waterloo" or "Bank".

ticket.description: HK only: octopus (default, the Octopus card fare) or single (single-journey ticket; adult and senior only).

to_station.description: HK only (required): the MTR station you end at, by English name such as 'Mong Kok' or 'Tung Chung'.

travel_time.description: early = the discounted band before the morning peak where a country has one; other = all other times (default). Australia (NSW Opal): other = peak, the full fare (default); early = off-peak (30% cheaper on train, bus and light rail; ferries have no off-peak discount). Spain (rail): not used, CNMC averages over departure times and purchase days; leave out. France (Île-de-France): no early band; leave out. London (Underground): not used; use tfl_time (peak or off-peak) instead. Hong Kong (MTR): not used; MTR fares do not change with the time of day in this table. Singapore: early = before 7.45am on weekdays (discounted fares), other = all other times (default). Singapore bus: not used, trunk bus fares have no early-morning discount. Taiwan (Taipei Metro): not used; this fare table does not change with the time of day.

name: pricepaid_transport_fares

outputSchema.description: A price answer: a range or an official statistic with sample size, period, confidence, source and licence.

answer_id.description: Audit trail: a stable id (hash of source id, normalised query, data period and method_version). The same question on the same data gives the same id; keep it with the reasoning that used the figure.

as_of.description: When the answer was produced (ISO 8601); the snapshot date when the official source was down and the answer comes from our copy.

data_age_days.description: Whole days between data_as_of and retrieved_at; null when data_as_of is null.

data_as_of.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) of the newest data point behind the figure; null when unknown.

evidence.description: Audit trail: what kind of evidence the figure is.

label.description: Short name of the kind of evidence, e.g. 'Recorded sale prices', 'Official published average', 'Official published index', 'Posted shelf or pump price', 'Posted or listed price', 'Contract award value', 'Regulated reimbursement price'.

meaning.description: One sentence on what this kind of evidence does and does not establish.

extra.description: Source-specific details (for example cheapest stations). extra.stale is true when the answer comes from our copy of the source.

method_version.description: Audit trail: version of the way this source turns raw data into an answer (per source, default '1').

notice.description: Information, not a valuation or offer. Also says when the answer is our copy because the official source did not respond.

period.description: The period the records cover (ISO dates), or the date of the snapshot when the answer comes from our copy.

anyOf.description: The price. Null when there is not enough data to publish a figure (fewer than 5 records) or nothing matched.

measure.description: What value is: median for ranges built from records; average or median for official statistics.

typical_high.description: 90th percentile; null for official statistics that give no range.

typical_low.description: 10th percentile; null for official statistics that give no range.

unit.description: What the price is per, e.g. 'per litre', 'per home', 'per kWh'.

value.description: The headline figure. For ranges built from records it equals median.

price_type.description: transaction, posted_pump_price, posted_price, contract_price, reimbursement_price or official_statistic.

query.description: The request as understood, echoed back.

reliability.description: How far to trust the figure as a distribution of real prices. official_with_count = a published official figure with a record count; official_median_no_count = a published average or median with no record count (confidence 'high' there means the publisher is official, not that a count was checked); record_level = 15+ records we hold; thin = 5–14 records; stale = our copy because the official source did not respond; insufficient_data = no figure published.

retrieved_at.description: Audit trail: when ProofPrice produced this answer (ISO 8601). For an answer from our own copy this is now, while as_of is the snapshot date.

sample_size.description: Number of records behind the figure; null when the publisher does not say.

source.description: Where the figure comes from, under which licence, and the attribution line to show.

attribution.description: The attribution line to show with the figure.

url.description: The publisher's page for this data.

statistic.description: Official statistics only: what kind of figure it is and the period the publisher states it for.

status.description: ok = a figure is returned; insufficient_data = fewer than 5 matching records; no_matches = nothing matched.

suggestions.description: Short plain things to try next: widen the period or area, ask for an itemised quote. May be empty.

summary.description: One plain sentence an AI can quote.

title: Public transport fares (posted fare tables)
